hid-dock 1.0.0

- Initial release with Windows-only support for the Acasis Flow HID dock (VID=0x35e6, PID=0xa4ac).
- Provides commands to connect, check status, switch dock views/pages, read from, and send data to the dock.
- Self-contained CLI automatically downloaded and installed for Windows x64.
- Includes detailed usage instructions and a protocol reference for 64-byte HID reports.
- NOT intended for generic HID devices or automation of mouse/keyboard actions.
